title: Cockpit function registry (issue #565, RC-10 of #551)
description: The one declaration of every cockpit function: the panels the cockpit renders, the views it offers and the commands the operator types. A function outside this file does not exist.

kinds.description: Closed map of function kind -> meaning. The kind set is exactly these three keys.

parameter_types.description: Closed map of parameter type -> meaning. A parameter with no type is a defect.

roles.description: Closed map of role -> what it is designed for. Role suitability is ADDITIVE FILTERING ONLY (ADR-0026 decision 9); it never grants permission.

consumes.description: The authorities this registry consumes, each verified by the gate against the live article.

renders.description: The panels the existing cockpit renders (a section title) -> the function that owns it. Both directions are checked.

id.description: The operator-typed mnemonic: upper case, Bloomberg-function style.

endpoints.description: The control-API endpoints it binds (`<family>/<action>`), each of which must resolve in RC-3's declared route set.

stream.description: The live surface it subscribes to, when it is live.

default.description: The default the cockpit presents. null means "the lever's own default applies".

values.description: Required when type is `enum`: the closed value list.

scope.description: The scope requirement: the identity/rbac capability and the tenant scope. Permission lives here and nowhere else.

capability.description: Must be a capability RC-2's vocabulary declares.

level.description: Must be a scope level identity/rbac declares.

tenant.description: The tenant scope the control path authorises at.

effect_class.description: RC-2's closed vocabulary, reused rather than re-invented.

audit.description: MUST be null for a read function and non-null for any other (RC-2's two-way rule).

flags.description: Every feature flag the function's visibility depends on, read from infra/feature-flags/registry.yaml.

roles.description: Designed for. Additive filtering only -- never permission.
